recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的細胞團塊（particle）中可見數顆大型、核深染的巨核細胞，巨核細胞數量不減少，周圍有紅血球系與骨髓系前驅細胞及嗜伊紅球；在血小板低下病人，巨核細胞正常或增加提示周邊破壞型血小板低下，如 HIV 相關血小板低下。
features: Cellular marrow particle containing several megakaryocytes
Megakaryocytes vary in size, several with dense, hyperchromatic, compact nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Numerous erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and myeloid precursors
No clusters of blasts or overt dysplasia identifiable at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing several megakaryocytes of varying size, some with dense hyperchromatic nuclei, together with trilineage hematopoietic precursors and occasional eosinophils. Megakaryocytes are not decreased. Detailed assessment of dysplasia is limited by cell overlap within the particle. In a patient with HIV infection and isolated thrombocytopenia, adequate to increased megakaryocytes support a peripheral destructive mechanism (immune thrombocytopenia), although HIV-associated marrow dysplasia and ineffective megakaryopoiesis may coexist.

ddx.vs: Marrow appearance is indistinguishable; separation relies on HIV serology and clinical context.
Shows small hypolobated micromegakaryocytes or separated nuclear lobes with dysplasia in other lineages and often clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Megakaryocytes are decreased or absent rather than preserved.
